name: Tetsuman
description: With Malairion controlling all of the Nebula in Elektra, how can the superheroes stop him? Well... They have their own secret weapon, and his name is Tetsuman! Built with cutting-edge technology, countless fighting techniques, and a mission to protect the innocent, Tetsuman is set to give the villains a nightmare or two.

skillset.name: Shocking Kata
skillset.description: Deals moderate Thunder damage to one enemy. Applies Shock to one enemy.

skillset.name: Shinobi Technique
skillset.description: Deals low Nature damage to all enemies

skillset.name: Karlo Chop
skillset.description: Deals moderate Nature damage to one enemy. Applies Poison to one enemy. Requires cooldown.

skillset.name: Swift Tekki
skillset.description: Deals low Thunder damage to one enemy. Gives 1 extra turn to itself. Requires cooldown.

skillset.name: Shockwave
skillset.description: Deals moderate Natura damage to one enemy. Applies Poison and Bleed to all enemies. Requires cooldown.

skillset.name: No Weak Spots
skillset.description: Applies Fire Immunity and a random Protection to itself. Gives 1 extra turn to itself. Requires cooldown.

skillset.name: Underdog Fury
skillset.description: Deals moderate Nature damage to all enemies. Applies Shock and Burn to all enemies. Requires cooldown.

skillset.name: Inspired by the Crowd
skillset.description: Applies Damage Boost and Precision to itself. Gives 1 extra turn to itself. Requires cooldown.

ult-ability.name: Never Second Best!
ult-ability.ult-description: Applies Nanovirus and Bleed to all enemies. Restores all cooldowns on itself. Gives 1 extra turn to itself.
